title: Radix Loans
tagline: Radix-Loans-0.1.0 aims to revolutionize finance with a secure, transparent, and efficient decentralized lending platform. We empower individuals and businesses with innovative blockchain-based solutions, creating an inclusive ecosystem for seamless loan access and collateral.
description:
Radix-Loans-0.1.0 is a cutting-edge decentralized finance (DeFi) platform that offers a unique approach to lending through the implementation of Harberger taxes. Our platform allows borrowers to secure loans by depositing tokenized assets as collateral, which they can self-assess and adjust over time. By incorporating a continuous tax mechanism based on the self-assessed value of the collateral, we ensure a dynamic and fair loan market.

Key Features:

Collateral Management: Borrowers can deposit various tokenized assets as collateral, setting their own valuation and adjusting it as needed.

Harberger Tax System: A continuous tax is levied on the collateral's self-assessed value, incentivizing accurate valuations and ensuring liquidity in the market.

Flexible Loan Issuance: Borrowers can access loans based on a percentage of their collateral's value, with the ability to adjust terms dynamically.

Transparent Liquidation: If a third party believes the self-assessed value is too low, they can purchase the collateral by paying the self-assessed value plus a premium, ensuring fair market practices.

Secure and Efficient: Built on robust blockchain technology, Loan-0.1.0 ensures the security and efficiency of all transactions and contract executions.

Radix-Loans-0.1.0 is dedicated to transforming the DeFi lending landscape by offering a platform that is not only innovative but also user-centric, transparent, and inclusive. Join us in our mission to redefine financial freedom in the decentralized era.

how_its_made:
This project involves the development of a decentralized application (dApp) utilizing StarkNet contracts written in the Cairo programming language. StarkNet is a Layer 2 solution designed to provide scalability and increased throughput for Ethereum by processing transactions off-chain and then submitting proofs to the main Ethereum network. The Cairo programming language, specifically designed for StarkNet, allows developers to write highly efficient smart contracts that leverage the advanced cryptographic proofs of the network.

For the frontend of this dApp, we utilized a Tailwind UI template. Tailwind UI is a collection of professionally designed, pre-built, fully responsive HTML components that are built on top of the Tailwind CSS framework. This allows for rapid development and ensures that the user interface is both modern and highly customizable.
